character.description: the same recurring anime protagonist in the nature world, with consistent face, hairstyle, outfit silhouette, age impression, and body proportions throughout the entire music video
consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in wildflower meadow, ancient forest, rocky coast; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with leaf green, sky blue, soft white, sunset gold; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide landscape shot, slow tracking through grass, macro flower close-up; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
